attacks.attack: Exact contraction may be nonlocal and many-body; current belief sections may be recognition parameters rather than Q-independent coarse samples; live-peer KL is not generically a fixed-joint state ELBO; GL gauge volume may be nonnormalizable; and deterministic action convergence does not imply process-law ELBO convergence.
attacks.response: The exact contraction theorem survives under fixed typed variables. The stronger PIFB2 closure and both continuum targets are withheld. Live-peer terms are reclassified, the full residual is retained, compact and noncompact gauge cases are separated, and entropy/normalization are explicit.

independent_reconstruction.method: Reconstructed from the normalized microscopic posterior, a fixed coarse map, KL disintegration, and interaction projection without assuming the PIFB2 action.
independent_reconstruction.conclusion: The exact finite-lattice action theorem and the inconclusive boundary were reproduced independently.

oracle_erasure.method: Removed PIFB2 and MAgent from the derivational premises and checked which results remain.
oracle_erasure.conclusion: Exact contraction remains; only the choice and interpretation of the retained local operator basis depend on PIFB2 and MAgent intuition.
